hook_text: Your ears cannot grow new parts. Once loud noise damages them, the damage stays for life.
clip_script: A school next to a taxi rank in Johannesburg. Hooting, shouting, engines, music, all day long. That is noise pollution, and it makes it hard to learn. Now listen to Kabelo. After a match full of vuvuzelas, his ears rang for a whole day. Deep inside your ear are tiny hairs that bend with every sound. Very loud sounds can break them, and they never grow back. So turn it down, take breaks, step away and wear earplugs. Your ears have to last a lifetime.
visual_style: Whiteboard busy taxi rank and stadium full of noise lines, then a close-up of an ear with tiny hairs bending, then earmuffs and a volume dial turning down.
mood: Serious but hopeful, like a friendly safety talk.
pacing: What noise pollution is, how loud sound damages hearing, then five easy ways to protect your ears.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and check the volume on your earphones today.
